items.text: Further disorders at Peshawar increased apprehension here today that grave events may be shaping themselves in the buffer northwest frontier province. Lahore dispatches to the London Daily Mail said a mob paraded the streets yesterday and taunted troops on guard. A British officer, facing the ring leaders with a drawn revolver, tried in vain to persuade them to disperse their followers. (/P). —The body of Robert Bridges, poet laureate of England, was cremated yesterday at Qolder’s Green with such secrecy that even the closest friends of the family were unaware of it. The poet’s widow and daughter were among the few who were present. There were no flowers. He died Monday.
